fields.label: Gateway Host
fields.description: Public host/IP clients hit; used to build the base_url returned by provision_endpoint.

fields.label: Metrics Remote Write URL
fields.description: Where a Monitoring Agent pushes when its Region names no endpoint of its own, e.g. http://13.206.253.38:8000/v1/write. Prefer https — the agent's token crosses the network on every push. The token itself lives on each agent.

fields.label: Service Discovery Token
fields.description: 16+ characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~ — e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Every Monitoring Agent sends it to fetch its target list, and it is the only thing guarding that list; unset, the endpoint refuses everyone. It travels in the query string, so it appears in this site's access log — rotate it here and hit Install on each agent.

fields.label: Metrics Scrape Password
fields.description: Guards /metrics/node and /metrics/gpu on every box — e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Boxes get its hash, the agent gets the password. Unset, a box writes no htpasswd at all and nginx refuses the endpoint. Rotating it means re-running each box's play (Setup, Update Engine Config, deploy_openresty.yml) and Install on each agent.

fields.label: Metrics Scrape Password Hash
fields.description: Derived from the password above and written to each box's htpasswd file. Recomputed only when the password changes, so re-running a play does not rewrite the file.

fields.label: Extra Labels
fields.description: JSON stamped on every series pushed from every box, e.g. {"env": "prod", "tenant": "grove"}.
